description: Checks one live product page's structured data the way the free schema checker does: each Product, ProductGroup and Offer field by field against the fields Google lists for merchant listings (name, image, offers, price above zero, priceCurrency in ISO 4217, availability, shipping, returns, brand, GTIN, variants, ratings), each present, missing or invalid with what to do, and a guess at whether a shopper can buy on the page. Use it on one product URL per template before and after a fix. It reads only what the page publishes; Merchant Center and Google decide eligibility for any Google feature.

url.description: The product page, as a full public address such as https://example.com/products/linen-shirt.

name: mttr_product_check
title: Check a product page
